newsitem.title: ZAIRE: New Congo says borders are technically open.
newsitem.headline: New Congo says borders are technically open.

text.p: Laurent Kabila's Democratic Republic of Congo said on Saturday there was no technical reason why borders should remain closed a week after a rebel takeover and that regular flights could start by Tuesday.
Transport Minister Henri Mova told a news conference that security considerations were to blame for the fact that travellers had been stopped from leaving Kinshasa.
"It now remains to complete a certain number of elements in consultation with the authorities in charge of security," Mova said. "The borders are open".
Since the Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo seized Kinshasa a week ago, movement across all borders has been severely restricted.
While a number of people were permitted to leave Kinshasa on Friday by boat for the capital of neighbouring Congo, Brazzaville, nobody has been allowed to enter Kinshasa by official channels.
Some people have crossed the five km (three mile) Congo river in dug-out canoes.
